inscribed_power.desc.text:
_+1:_ When the Mage reads a scroll or uses a spell item, his _next 2 wand zaps_ get +2 levels.

_+2:_ When the Mage reads a scroll or uses a spell item, his _next 3 wand zaps_ get +2 levels.

The number of enhanced wand zaps is doubled when using a scroll of upgrade, transmutation, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those scrolls.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. most spells), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.

wand_preservation.meta_desc.text: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase the amount of arcane resin gained when putting a wand into an alchemy pot by 1 at +1, or by 2 at +2.

facets.facet: Successful scroll/spell activation versus a generic item-use claim
evidence: Scroll.readAnimation calls Talent.onScrollUsed only after its existing talentChance roll, at Scroll.java:226-227.
InventorySpell.java:82-102 invokes the hook after valid non-null item selection; MagicalInfusion delegates to its separate committed useAnimation.
TargetedSpell.onSpellused at lines60-67 invokes the hook on its actual use completion path.
SummonElemental.java:113-126 invokes it after a successful summon; its no-space branch does not consume/trigger.
BeaconOfReturning.java:218-221 invokes it when a spell item is consumed for return.
UnstableSpell.java:112-118 gives the generated scroll factor/chance 1 and relies on that scroll to trigger once.
Talent.onScrollUsed at Talent.java:765-769 offers (int)(factor * (1 + rank)) uses. onRunestoneUsed does not activate Inscribed Power.
facets.interpretation: The ordinary scroll/spell statement matches completed eligible use paths. Cancellation, failed placement and a free non-consuming configuration action are not claimed to be triggers. The prior +2-level/max-remaining-use numerical review was reused, not repeated.

facets.facet: Doubled number of empowered zaps for mandatory upgrade/transmutation-derived sources
evidence: ScrollOfEnchantment.java:52 and ScrollOfMetamorphosis.java:54 also set talentFactor=2.
MagicalInfusion.java:52 sets factor2; its recipe at131-137 requires ScrollOfUpgrade and produces one item.
Recycle.java:50 sets factor2; its recipe at107-116 requires ScrollOfTransmutation and produces twelve items.
Talent.onScrollUsed multiplies the source factor by 1 + talent rank, so a fresh successful doubled source offers 4/6 uses rather than 2/3.
facets.limits: This compares the identified required-source families. A spell that can optionally be crafted or modified with those scrolls is not automatically a mandatory-source recipe. Existing remaining-use replacement and stronger-effect interactions were not reopened.

facets.facet: Batch-produced spell items have a recipe-output-based chance to trigger
evidence: InventorySpell and TargetedSpell compare Random.Float() with that chance before calling the real hook.
Alchemize.java:303-304, BeaconOfReturning.java:220-221 and SummonElemental.java:125-126 have corresponding explicit chance gates.
One-output MagicalInfusion retains the default chance1. UnstableSpell produces one item and delegates one factor1/chance1 trigger to its generated scroll.
facets.limits: No empirical RNG distribution or new item-use test was run. This is a direct comparison of the existing probability predicates and recipe outputs, not a whole crafted-item behavior review.
